canonical_title: GlobalFoundries selected to operate two New York fabs under US-Japan investment plan
aliases: GF Malta US Japan two fab investment
treatment: Track concrete milestones and final funding; do not conflate with the separate October 8 GlobalFoundries-TSMC $2B silicon interposer deal.
known_facts: GlobalFoundries officially announced October 14 that it was selected as technology provider and operator for two fabs at Malta, New York under a US-Japan initiative worth up to $21B.
Japan will provide investment capital; first ~$10B 300mm fab is expected online in 2029, second ~$10B fab is additional/conditional.

GF says each fab could add about 900,000 300mm wafers/year when fully operational; capacity is aimed primarily at foundational/automotive/industrial/connected infrastructure semiconductors rather than immediate frontier GPU production.
Reuters first reported the new deal at 12:30 UTC (21:30 JST).
reinclude_only_if: Binding funding/ownership agreement or concrete second-fab commitment.
Construction, technology node, schedule, customers or capacity materially change.
notes: Night hard delta; distinct from GlobalFoundries TSMC CoWoS interposer supply agreement reported Oct 8.
